step1_analysis.description: A 2-input symmetric NAND gate with redundant parallel pull-down paths. It is typically used as a delay cell in a voltage-controlled oscillator (VCO) or as a phase detector component in a DLL/PLL to ensure equal propagation delays for both inputs.

paper_reference.title: Techniques for Phase Noise Suppression in Recirculating DLLs

operating_frequency.description: Maximum operating frequency (proxy for VCO frequency)

sky130_expected.reasoning: A single gate is much faster than the full VCO loop. The 160-190MHz reported is for the entire multi-stage VCO.

gain.description: Small-signal voltage gain at the switching threshold (proxy for phase noise suppression gain)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard CMOS inverter/NAND gain in the transition region.

capacitance.description: Input capacitance of the gate (proxy for loop filter capacitance)

sky130_expected.calculation: Cgs + Cgd of M1, M4, M5
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gate capacitance for W=5u L=0.5u is roughly 5u*0.5u*10fF/um2 = 25fF. The nF values in the paper refer to the system loop filter.

efficiency_ratio.description: Switching threshold voltage ratio Vth/VDD (proxy for efficiency/ratio)

sky130_expected.reasoning: A symmetric NAND should switch near VDD/2 (50%).
Expected delay for 0.5um length devices driving a 50fF load.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure transient delay, power, AC gain, input capacitance, and DC switching threshold of the symmetric NAND gate.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Symmetric NAND2 Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
* Input A configured for DC sweep, AC analysis, and Transient pulse
VA A 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 PULSE(0 1.8 1n 50p 50p 2n 4n)
VB B 0 DC 1.8

* DUT
XM1 N4 A GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N5 B GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUT B N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUT A N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 OUT A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 OUT B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

Cload OUT 0 50f

.control
* 1. Transient Analysis
tran 10p 10n
meas tran t_delay_fall trig v(A) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_delay_rise trig v(A) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(OUT) val=0.9 rise=1
let pwr = -i(VVDD)*1.8
meas tran power_avg avg pwr
let t_delay_avg = (t_delay_fall + t_delay_rise) / 2
let operating_frequency = 1 / (2 * t_delay_avg)
print t_delay_avg operating_frequency

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 10 1Meg 1Gig
meas ac max_gain_db max vdb(OUT)
let omega = 2 * pi * frequency
let cap = abs(im(i(VA))) / omega
meas ac capacitance avg cap
print max_gain_db capacitance

* 3. DC Sweep
dc VA 0 1.8 0.01
meas dc vth_switching find v(A) when v(OUT)=0.9 fall=1
let efficiency_ratio = (vth_switching / 1.8) * 100
print efficiency_ratio

quit
.endc
